what: Randomization, Allocation Concealment and Blinding for Clinical Trials
title: Randomization, Allocation Concealment and Blinding for Clinical Trials
text: Reproducible randomization, allocation concealment, treatment-code management, unblinding audits, CONSORT/SPIRIT study operations, adverse-event summaries, blinding assessment, explicit analysis populations, endpoint helpers clinical trials. also creates linked SDTM-shaped ADaM-shaped datasets deterministic structural validation define.xml metadata stubs. CONSORT counts DOT remain inspectable without rendering dependency: ITT per-protocol membership consume explicit finalized assignments: Trial exports keep source--USUBJID map sponsor mappings explicit: auditable, structurally checked exports. claim formal CDISC, third-party validator, regulatory acceptance. Randomization, Allocation Concealment Blinding Clinical Trials
code: library(PhysioTrial)  trial <- Trial(   "rehab-01",   arms = c("active", "control"),   strata = list(site = c("north", "south")) ) participants <- data.frame(   id = sprintf("P%03d", 1:8),   site = rep(c("north", "south"), each = 4) )  sequence <- randomize(   trial,   method = "stratified_block",   participants = participants,   seed = 2026 )  # Future treatment assignments remain masked. assignments(sequence)  allocation <- nextAllocation(sequence, requester = "site") allocation$arm sequence <- allocation$sequence flow <- data.frame(   participant_id = c("P001", "P002"),   eligible = c(TRUE, FALSE),   randomized = c(TRUE, FALSE),   arm = c("active", NA),   received_allocated = c(TRUE, NA),   followup_complete = c(TRUE, NA),   analysed = c(TRUE, NA),   pre_exclusion_reason = c(NA, "ineligible"),   not_received_reason = NA_character_,   followup_reason = NA_character_,   analysis_exclusion_reason = NA_character_ ) diagram <- consortDiagram(trial, flow, render = FALSE) consortCounts(diagram) participant_state <- data.frame(   id = c("P001", "P002", "screen-01"),   arm = c("active", "control", NA),   randomized = c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE),   adherent = c(TRUE, FALSE, NA) ) itt <- intentionToTreat(trial, participant_state) pp <- perProtocol(   trial,   participant_state,   adherent_col = "adherent" ) analysisExclusions(pp) sdtm <- toSDTM(trial, participant_state) validateCDISC(sdtm) sdtm$metadata$id_map

title: PhysioTrial 0.5.0
text: Power sample-size rehabilitation trial designs (R/power.R) — package previously run report trial size power one. sampleSizeContinuous() / powerContinuous() — two-arm continuous endpoint, cross-validated base stats::power.t.test; adds unequal allocation, one/two-sided, dropout inflation, cluster design effect. sampleSizeANCOVA() — recommended pre-post analysis, baseline-adjusted (variance x (1 - rho^2)); sampleSizeChangeScore() — change--baseline (SD x sqrt(2(1 - rho))); sampleSizeRepeatedMeasures() — mean repeated post-baseline visits compound symmetry (Frison & Pocock). sampleSizeBinary() / powerBinary() — two-proportion / responder endpoint, matching stats::power.prop.test. powerCurve() planning; estimateBaselineCorrelation() estimates rho ANCOVA planning pilot vectors, data frame, PhysioCohort. share cluster (ICC design effect) dropout modifiers return printable trial_power object.

title: PhysioTrial 0.4.0
text: Adds deterministic, linked SDTM-shaped DM, AE, VS, EG, sponsor-defined XP exports plus validated passthrough domains. Adds ADaM-shaped ADSL generic BDS exports preserving explicit analysis-set membership exclusion metadata. Adds structural validation deterministic define.xml metadata stubs without claiming formal regulatory conformance.

title: PhysioTrial 0.3.0
text: Adds explicit ITT per-protocol analysis sets deterministic exclusion reasons. Adds source-order-preserving outcome filtering, LOCF sensitivity handling, explicit multiple-imputation callbacks. Adds ANCOVA, delegated MMRM, delegated MDC/MCID responder summaries.

title: PhysioTrial 0.2.0
text: Adds reconciled CONSORT participant-flow counts optional DiagrammeR rendering. Adds SPIRIT schedule--events tables SPIRIT 2013 checklist helper. Adds typed adverse-event capture AE/SAE summaries arm, severity, term.

title: PhysioTrial 0.1.0
text: Adds S4 models trial arms, participants, randomized trials, concealed randomization sequences, blinding management. Supports simple, permuted-block, stratified-block, Pocock-Simon minimization allocation captured seeds deterministic fingerprints. Adds treatment-code management, append-unblinding logs, Bang blinding-index estimates.
